evidence.quote: When you click "done" the download will start and the pdf will be automatically attached to the new library entry.
This is a [Zotero](https://www.zotero.org) plugin (also called add-on) for downloading whole manuscripts as pdfs from [DigiVatLib](https://digi.vatlib.it/).

checkNote: The plugin downloads IIIF manuscripts from DigiVatLib. The pack shows no key storage and no key setting in prefs, and the README mentions no key. It has no AI features. The plugin was not sandbox-tested, but the static evidence is consistent.
